description: This file implements the LocalizationService class for managing localization, font settings, and regional formatting in a Windows-based application, including singleton management, font property updates, and locale-aware formatters.

classes.name: LocalizationService
classes.description: Singleton class providing localization, font, and regional formatting services, including locale-aware formatters, font property management, and text-to-speech token translation.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LocalizationService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: OverrideWithLanguage
methods.description: Replaces the singleton instance with a new one configured for a specific language, mainly for testing.

methods.name: GetFlowDirection
methods.description: Returns the layout flow direction (LTR or RTL).

methods.name: IsRtlLayout
methods.description: Checks if the current layout is right-to-left.

methods.name: GetOverrideFontApiValues
methods.description: Indicates whether font override values are used.

methods.name: GetLanguageFontFamilyForType
methods.description: Returns the font family for a specified language font type, considering overrides.

methods.name: GetLanguageFont
methods.description: Returns the font details for a specified language font type.

methods.name: GetFontFamilyOverride
methods.description: Returns the font family override string.

methods.name: GetFontScaleFactorOverride
methods.description: Returns the font scale factor override for a given font type.

methods.name: GetRegionalSettingsAwareDecimalFormatter
methods.description: Returns a decimal formatter respecting regional settings.

methods.name: GetRegionalSettingsAwareDateTimeFormatter
methods.description: Returns a date-time formatter respecting regional settings, with optional format string.

methods.name: GetRegionalSettingsAwareCurrencyFormatter
methods.description: Returns a currency formatter respecting regional settings.

methods.name: GetNarratorReadableToken
methods.description: Converts a raw token string into a narrator-friendly string, using resource mappings.

methods.name: GetNarratorReadableString
methods.description: Converts a raw string into a narrator-friendly string by tokenizing and mapping.

methods.name: Sort
methods.description: Sorts a vector of strings according to locale-specific collation.
